C0978.title: Newbee Dota 2 Match-Fixing Scandal
C0978.summary: In February 2020, Chinese Dota 2 team Newbee was suspected of intentionally feeding and match-fixing during the SL-l Kyiv Major qualifiers. Despite holding a gold lead, they lost the first game, staged a comeback after creating a false impression of a large deficit in the second, and won the third. The abnormal match patterns led players to suspect deliberate point manipulation for off-site bettin
